title: Croissants
description: A traditional France dish made with all-purpose flour, whole cow milk, instant yeast, chicken egg. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 32 minutes.
Enclose cold butter in chilled dough, roll and fold the dough in thirds three times, chilling between folds; keep butter firm and layers intact.
Roll the laminated dough into a long rectangle, cut triangles, then roll each from base to tip to form croissants.
Proof the shaped croissants at cool room temperature until light and visibly expanded, about 90–110 minutes. Keep them below butter-melting temperature.
Brush the proofed croissants gently with egg wash; bake at 205–215°C for 18–22 minutes until the butter-rich layers are crisp and deeply golden.
